name: Castillo de Bayuela (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned arms of Castillo de Bayuela within a border inscribed AVE MARIA GRATIA PLENA.
history: Municipal flag of Castillo de Bayuela; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base at the hoist and its apex at the centre
